title: MessageSieve: Runtime Message Pruning for Accurate and Efficient LLM-Based Multi-Agent Communication
read_scope: Primary metadata, methods3, appendixA and relevant experimental protocol; pinned code interface reviewed and artificial CPU check, no task performance reproduction
finding: Fixed-graph, message-instance pruning via lightweight state cards and local comparisons; no extra selector training or model call.
implication: Mandatory near baseline for claims about free message filtering; graph-conditioned feedback is a distinct claim requiring evidence.

title: What Should Agents Say? Action-state Communication for Efficient Multi-Agent Systems
read_scope: Primary metadata, abstract, sections3-5 and main tables; code not reproduced
finding: PACT projects messages into action/state/result records. Split-evidence experiments include HotpotQA and 2Wiki; generic summaries and conclusion-only messages have topology-dependent limitations.
implication: Split evidence and preserving grounded communication are established, not novel here. Need matched PACT control before a broad system claim.

title: CompAct: Compressing Retrieved Documents Actively for Question Answering
finding: Active document compression for multihop QA retains task-relevant information.
implication: Evidence compression alone is not a new contribution. Full method still needs reading before claiming an implementation match.
